scope: Original offline generated audio for a noncommercial hobby/evaluation game. No model weights, inference server, Python or ffmpeg required by shipped game.
creativeDirection: Grounded abandoned industrial station; restrained pressure, sparse original bowed-metal score, tactile mechanical foley, clear short dialogue, no gunfire or musical jump-scare stingers.
nativeMasters: Retain native ACE-Step FLAC, SFX float32 WAV and Azure raw/final WAV in the session production archive. Runtime Ogg Opus is an encode, not a master.

soundEffects.method: Nine original model-generated waveforms, not physical field recordings or third-party sample-library recordings. DSP adds filtering, controlled dynamics, editorial cuts, endpoint fades and offline loop overlaps; no oscillator beep is substituted for a generated sound.
soundEffects.actualSourceMetadata: source/native-sfx/*.json contains actual native output hashes, shapes, seeds, prompts and settings. Native WAV files remain in the production archive.
soundEffects.deferred: Separate grating footsteps were not generated: integrator confirmed no authored grating surface state, so four distinct solid-deck source strikes are the used variants.
